scripts.build:sites: tsc -b && vite build --mode sites --outDir dist/client && node scripts/prepare-sites-build.mjs
scripts.check:contracts: npm run generate:contracts && git diff --exit-code -- src/contracts/life-console.ts
scripts.test: npm run check:contracts && vitest run && npm run test:python
scripts.test:contracts: npm run check:contracts && vitest run tests/contract
scripts.test:python: python3 -m unittest discover -v -s tests/hub -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -v -s tests/packaging -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -v -s tests/e2e -p 'test_*.py'
